cylinder_position.purpose: Compare endpoint feedback with the endpoint expected for the current simulated action.
cylinder_position.limitation: Cylinder endpoint feedback does not establish gripping force or plate retention. Actual cylinder roles are unspecified.

correct_tool_attached.purpose: Compare the observed simulated tool identity with the configured expected tool.
correct_tool_attached.limitation: Tool IDs and expected tool assignments must be configured; unknown is not a pass.

part_present_in_fixture.purpose: Corroborate visual part presence only for a fixture explicitly assigned a sensor.
part_present_in_fixture.limitation: Only a few parts have sensors. This is not evidence that either Light Localizer plate position has one, or that a part is correctly seated.

simulation_rules: Keep simulated PLC signals separate from visual observations and scenario ground truth.
Unknown, contradictory, or stale required feedback blocks automatic simulated recovery.
Check expected cylinder endpoints per action; do not require all cylinders to be in the same position.
Fixture presence sensing is usable only after explicit per-fixture configuration.
Log signal values, source, timestamps, and the reason for each simulated recovery or intervention.
No physical PLC connection, robot commands, or actual recovery permission is provided by this configuration.
